cohort: Pregnant and puerperal women hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2 infection at Hospital Nacional Daniel Alcides Carrion in Callao, Peru.
finding: The majority of pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection were asymptomatic, and their clinical presentation did not significantly differ from the general population of similar age.
mod_finding: The study reported a cesarean section rate of 31% among the pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection.
